weakness: Shared Windows login and shared mailbox; no account procedure, approvals, reviews, or monitoring; 2 former employees active in the PMS
remediation_plan: Named Windows accounts with fast user switching; named mailboxes with delegated access to the front desk inbox; onboarding and termination checklist; monthly reconciliation
milestones: 2026-08-04 former employees disabled; 2026-09-30 checklist in use; 2026-10-31 named accounts live and first reconciliation
resources_required: MSP labor (about 3 hours); Assistant Manager time (1 hour a month)

weakness: Paper crew card forms (410, about 160 with security codes) in an open binder since 2021; about 640 card emails in the shared mailbox
remediation_plan: Lock the binder in the back office; shred and delete everything with a security code; purge the rest after billing checks; pay-by-link replaces forms; written notice to the 14 crew companies
milestones: 2026-08-05 binder locked; 2026-09-30 security codes destroyed; 2026-10-15 crew companies notified; 2026-11-30 no stored card data
resources_required: Staff time; pay-by-link included in the gateway plan

weakness: Lock vendor remote tool always on, shared password, no MFA, no authorization before sessions
source: P07 (AC-17 objectives); P01 R-001; P04 finding 1
remediation_plan: Set the tool to start only when the motel accepts a session; one-time code per session; remote access log; written remote access and incident notice terms with the lock vendor
milestones: 2026-08-05 tool set to manual start; 2026-09-30 one-time codes; 2026-10-31 written terms
resources_required: Lock vendor time; Assistant Manager time

weakness: Firewall management login and the Assistant Manager's gateway portal login accept a password alone; front office PMS users have no MFA
remediation_plan: MSP enables MFA on the firewall login; MFA on the gateway portal; MFA for every PMS user and mailbox
milestones: 2026-09-15 firewall and gateway portal; 2026-10-31 all PMS users and mailboxes

weakness: Flat office network: terminals, PCs, CCTV recorder, and tablets reachable from each other; firewall logs not reviewed
remediation_plan: Separate networks for terminals, lock system and CCTV, and office PCs with deny-by-default rules; outbound rules for the terminal network; firewall logs to the MSP's log service
milestones: 2026-10-31 design approved; 2026-12-31 networks live and tested
resources_required: About $1,500 one-time (managed switch and MSP labor)

weakness: All 5 front office users can display full virtual card numbers
remediation_plan: Remove the permission from all but the Owner-Manager; switch on the PMS feature that charges virtual cards without display; then remove it from everyone
milestones: 2026-09-15 permission removed from 4 users; 2026-10-15 charge-without-display in use

weakness: Antivirus alerts reach the MSP only in business hours; no behavior-based detection on the front desk PC
remediation_plan: MSP-managed EDR with after-hours alerting on the 3 PCs; alerts to the Assistant Manager by text

weakness: No vulnerability scanning of any kind
remediation_plan: Quarterly ASV scans and internal scans by the MSP while the office network is in card data scope; firmware schedule for the firewall and recorder
milestones: 2026-10-31 first ASV and internal scans; 2026-12-31 second internal scan and firmware updated
resources_required: About $300 a year plus MSP labor

weakness: No review of PMS activity, sign-in, or firewall logs
remediation_plan: Weekly 20-minute review of PMS card displays, exports, and odd-hour sign-ins plus suite sign-in alerts, on a checklist; findings to the Owner-Manager monthly
milestones: 2026-09-07 first weekly review; 2026-10-31 eight reviews recorded
resources_required: Assistant Manager time (20 minutes a week)

weakness: Lock database excluded from the backup; no restore test; versions not immutable
remediation_plan: Add the lock database to the nightly job; restore test with the lock vendor; immutable versions; sealed emergency key cards
milestones: 2026-08-12 lock database added; 2026-10-31 first restore test; 2026-12-31 immutable versions
resources_required: About $300 a year; MSP labor (2 hours a quarter)

weakness: No security or privacy training; staff would give credentials to a caller
remediation_plan: Online training at hire and yearly; front desk module on card handling, phishing, and callers; monthly reminder at the staff meeting
milestones: 2026-09-30 caller rule card at the desk; 2026-10-31 all 7 trained

weakness: No incident reporting rule; staff unaware of the acquirer notice term
remediation_plan: Reporting card at the front desk (POL-03 4.2); covered in training; tabletop with the MSP

weakness: No provider list, responsibility matrix, or security terms with the MSP and lock vendor; MSP evidence not received
remediation_plan: Provider list and responsibility matrix; yearly AOC check; MSP security questionnaire with MFA evidence and technician list; contract terms at renewal
milestones: 2026-07-20 gateway AOC obtained; 2026-10-31 provider list and MSP questionnaire; 2026-12-31 contract terms

weakness: Inventory covers only the 3 PCs; terminal serial numbers not recorded
remediation_plan: One-page inventory of all devices, terminals with serial numbers, SaaS services, and data locations; weekly terminal inspection at night audit
milestones: 2026-09-15 terminal list and first inspection; 2026-10-31 full inventory
